exposure: Ultrasound (US) guidance during uterine balloon tamponade (UBT)
cohort: 370 women who underwent vaginal delivery and had postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) caused by uterine atony at Sant'Anna Hospital from 2015 to 2019.
finding: The use of ultrasound guidance for placement of UBT was associated with reduced need for balloon repositioning, lower blood loss, and faster resolution of postpartum hemorrhage.
